detail.title: Investigating Path-Dependent Divergence via Revised Hypothesis
detail.summary: This cycle continues the investigation into path-dependent value divergence within project proj-divergent-values-01. Building upon the previous experimental evaluation (exp-divergent-values-test-122) which yielded inconclusive results under revision 118, we propose a revised hypothesis and accompanying experiment to further test whether stochastic perturbation and coupling adjustments lead to reliable variance divergence.
